versions.verdictComment: The one version that doesn't restart in a Docker loop. No reported stability issues — clean slate so far.

stabilityScore.notes: Historical clean-slate tracking. No upstream issues linked yet. Docker users report v0.14.x as the stable baseline before v0.15.0 regressions.

versions.verdictComment: Gateway enters a restart loop on Docker 28.5.2+ (s6-overlay signal=UNKNOWN). Workaround: HERMES_GATEWAY_NO_SUPERVISE=1. Non-Docker installs unaffected.

evidence.reason: Gateway restart loop under s6-overlay on Docker 28.5.2+ (signal=UNKNOWN). Explicitly reproduced on v0.15.1. Workaround: HERMES_GATEWAY_NO_SUPERVISE=1.

stabilityScore.notes: Docker s6-overlay regression affecting all v0.15.x. Non-Docker (pipx/CLI) installs are unaffected by this issue. Canonical upstream report is closed as completed/duplicate; keep evidence until a post-fix npm version is published.

versions.verdictComment: Gateway plays dead in Docker 28.5.2+ and speaks raw i18n key-salad from pip installs. CLI/non-Docker use is fine. Two known bugs, both with workarounds.

evidence.reason: Gateway restart loop under s6-overlay on Docker 28.5.2+ (signal=UNKNOWN). Explicitly reproduced on v0.15.2. Workaround: HERMES_GATEWAY_NO_SUPERVISE=1.
PyPI wheel omits locales/ directory, causing slash commands to display raw i18n keys (e.g. gateway.model.switched) instead of human-readable text. Explicitly confirmed on v0.15.2.

stabilityScore.notes: npm package hermes-agent@0.15.2 published 2026-05-29. Two active upstream regressions: s6-overlay gateway restart loop (Docker 28.5.2+) and missing locales in PyPI wheel. Fix PRs pending upstream. Canonical upstream report is closed as completed/duplicate; keep evidence until a post-fix npm version is published.
